patch.value: Expose static extension inventory for hosted and agent reads

A default extension explore read activates installed extension code, so hosted GET routes need an explicit static configured-state inventory through the public SDK and CLI with honest completeness and error receipts.

Static CLI and SDK inventory never import or activate extension code, adopt state, check updates, or write workspace files; installed, absent, inactive, malformed, and global/project cases are distinct; completeness and errors are explicit; docs distinguish configured state from runtime probes.
